prompt.text: Call the task tool exactly once with three tasks in the same batch. Task "Ping": reply with the single word PONG and nothing else. Task "Count": count the files in the current directory with one find call and reply with the number. Task "Refuse": the subagent must not do the work; it must immediately end by yielding a failure (status aborted) with error "refused on purpose". Do not do anything else. After the task tool returns, reply with one short line.
